name: TeamSpeak 3 Master (64-bit)
description: TeamSpeak 3 server instance (master) for Windows x64. It starts with no virtual servers: add, change and remove them with the Create / Modify / Delete virtual server actions. The serveradmin ServerQuery password is the service RCON password, applied at every start. Query: total slots and connected clients across all virtual servers.

customPorts.description: Voice port (UDP) suggested for the first virtual server

configFiles.description: Main configuration file (ports and IPs come from the service)
configFiles.template:
machine_id=
default_voice_port=${GamePort}
voice_ip=${IPAddress}
licensepath=
filetransfer_port=${FileTransferPort}
filetransfer_ip=${IPAddress}
query_port=${QueryPort}
query_ip=${IPAddress}
query_protocols=raw
query_ip_allowlist=query_ip_allowlist.txt
query_ip_denylist=query_ip_denylist.txt
dbplugin=ts3db_sqlite3
dbpluginparameter=
dbsqlpath=sql/
dbsqlcreatepath=create_sqlite/
dbconnections=10
dblogkeepdays=90
dbclientkeepdays=30
logpath=logs
logquerycommands=0
logappend=1
query_skipbruteforcecheck=0

configFiles.description: IPs exempt from ServerQuery flood protection (one per line)
IPs that may not use ServerQuery (one per line)

script.name: Download TeamSpeak 3 server files
script.description: Downloads the latest Windows x64 build from the official TeamSpeak version feed and verifies its SHA-256.

script.name: TeamSpeak master query
script.description: Max players = slots of all virtual servers; players = voice clients on all running virtual servers.

script.name: TeamSpeak ServerQuery console
script.description: Runs console input as ServerQuery commands as serveradmin. Chain commands with ";" (e.g. use sid=1; clientlist).

script.name: Graceful shutdown
script.description: Stops the instance with serverprocessstop so every virtual server is saved and shut down cleanly.

script.name: Change serveradmin password
script.description: Changes the TeamSpeak serveradmin (ServerQuery) password, which is also the service RCON password. Generate = applied live; a specific password restarts the master.

script.name: TsHost
script.description: TeamSpeak Browser API: the master instance (info, broadcast, instance log).

script.name: TsVirtualServers
script.description: TeamSpeak Browser API: list, create, start, stop, edit and delete virtual servers.

script.name: TsClients
script.description: TeamSpeak Browser API: the clients of a virtual server (kick, poke, message, move, ban, groups).

script.name: TsChannels
script.description: TeamSpeak Browser API: the channel tree of a virtual server.

script.name: TsBans
script.description: TeamSpeak Browser API: the ban list of a virtual server.

script.name: TsPrivilegeKeys
script.description: TeamSpeak Browser API: the privilege keys of a virtual server.

script.name: TeamSpeak Browser
script.description: Manage every virtual server of this master: status, clients, channels, bans, privilege keys and logs.
script.code:
TeamSpeak Browser

${IPAddress}

script.name: Move update files into the service root
script.description: Runs after the Latest Version update is extracted: moves the contents of teamspeak3-server_win64/ over the service files and removes the wrapper folder.

updates.name: Latest Version
updates.comments: Downloads the latest TeamSpeak 3 server build and replaces the server files. The server is stopped while the update installs and started again afterwards; virtual servers and their data are kept.

metadata.notes: TeamSpeak 3 master (Windows x64), built for TCAdmin V3 from the V2 "TS3 Master - Windows" config.
